about_the_game:
This is an expansion pack that replaces the in-game music of Marisa of Liartop Mountain with the tracks listed below.

*This does not allow you to select individual tracks. All in-game music will be switched over at once.

※The 21st track "Insert Coin(s)" is scheduled to be added at a later date.

2 Lady in Purple Shadow
